summary: EQT Exeter Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two routine items: entry into a Second Amended and Restated Advisory Agreement with its adviser, extending the term through July 31, 2027, and declaring monthly distributions across share classes (~$0.04326 gross per share, net of fees for Class T). No special situation—no merger, tender, or strategic event. The advisory agreement renewal is ordinary-course. The filing is a routine current report; the distribution declaration is standard REIT activity. What to watch: future advisory agreement renewals, but no risk-arb angle.
